name: pdf_read
description:
Read and process EXISTING PDF files: extract text/images, merge, split, convert to images, search. This is for PDF INPUT processing, not creating new PDFs.

Use when:
- 'Extract text from this PDF' → action: extract_text
- 'What's in this PDF?' → action: info or extract_text
- 'Get images from PDF' → action: extract_images
- 'Merge these PDFs into one' → action: merge
- 'Split this PDF at page 5' → action: split
- 'Convert PDF pages to images' → action: to_images
- 'Search PDF for keyword' → action: search
- 'How many pages in this PDF?' → action: info

Do NOT use for:
- Creating new PDFs from scratch → use pdf_create instead
- Making reports/documents from text → use pdf_create instead
- Generating printable output → use pdf_create instead

Workflow direction:
- pdf_read: PDF → text/images/info (extract FROM pdf)
- pdf_create: text/images → PDF (generate TO pdf)

file_id.description: File ID or name in stash space

file_path.description: Direct file path (alternative to stash ref)

save_to_stash.description: Save extracted text to stash (for extract_text)

output_space_id.description: Stash space for output (creates new if not provided)

pdfs.description: List of stash_refs or paths (for merge action)

split_at.description: Page number(s) to split at, or 'each' for every page

min_size.description: Minimum image dimension to extract (filters small icons)
